component.name: Umbra
component.summary: Remote desktop and game streaming from a PC running Umbra Host or Sunshine

description.p: Umbra streams the desktop, games and other applications of another PC running Umbra Host or Sunshine. It is built on Moonlight.

ul.li: Hardware accelerated video decoding with VAAPI, VDPAU, and Vulkan Video support
H.264, HEVC, and AV1 codec support
Switching between the host's displays without leaving the stream
Support for both pointer capture (for games) and direct mouse control (for remote desktop)
Support for passing system-wide keyboard shortcuts like Alt+Tab to the host
